messages.subject: Project Lyra – engagement letter
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Nadia,

Thank you for instructing us on the Pennland Water software and managed-services deal (Project Lyra). I attach our engagement letter setting out scope, team and our fee estimate of £48,000–£62,000 plus VAT through to execution. James Osei will be your day-to-day contact.

Please countersign and return when convenient.

Kind regards,
Sarah

Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
